abi-bing-1.webp.zh: 阿比林地区机场俯瞰：白色帐篷状雨棚罩住落客车道，停机坪上一架客机正在登机。
abi-bing-1.webp.en: Aerial view of Abilene Regional Airport: white tent-like canopies over the drop-off loop, with an airliner boarding on the apron.

abi-bing-2.webp.zh: 塔台与航站楼的雨棚屋顶；一架 C-130 运输机正好从机场上空飞过。
abi-bing-2.webp.en: The control tower and the terminal's canopy roofs, with a C-130 transport passing overhead.

abi-bing-3.webp.zh: 沿跑道望向塔台：白色标线在深色沥青上向远处延伸，红白色塔台立在草原尽头。
abi-bing-3.webp.en: Looking along the runway towards the tower — white markings stretching across the dark asphalt to the red-and-white tower on the horizon.

abi-doubao-01.webp.zh: 航站楼前的租车停车区，红色遮阳棚下停着皮卡，旗杆上飘着得州州旗，远处一架客机停在滑行道上。
abi-doubao-01.webp.en: Pickups wait under red shades in the lot by the terminal, a Texas flag flying above, with an airliner out on the taxiway beyond the lawn.

abi-doubao-02.webp.zh: 停机坪上停着两架四发支线客机，红色尾翼朝向镜头，混凝土地面划着黄色标线，天空没有一丝云。
abi-doubao-02.webp.en: Two four-engined regional jets with red tails stand on the concrete apron, orange cones set out beside them beneath a cloudless deep blue sky.

abi-doubao-03.webp.zh: 红顶塔台紧挨着米黄色航站楼，草坪中间一棵大橡树枝叶繁茂，右侧停着一辆红色行李车。
abi-doubao-03.webp.en: A red-capped tower rises beside the tan terminal block, a broad live oak shading the lawn and a red baggage cart parked at the right.

abi-doubao-04.webp.zh: 航站楼外的两段自动扶梯从广场通向候机厅，白色张拉膜顶棚撑在混凝土柱上，右侧立着历史标记牌。
abi-doubao-04.webp.en: Twin escalators climb from the plaza to the terminal beneath a white tensile canopy held up by concrete columns, a historical marker standing to the right.

abi-doubao-05.webp.zh: 夜幕下的航站楼入口，成排白色雨棚被灯光照亮，旗杆上旗帜低垂，下方停车场里停着车辆。
abi-doubao-05.webp.en: At night the terminal's scalloped white canopies glow above the entrance, flags hanging still on their poles, with cars parked below in the darkness.

abi-doubao-06.webp.zh: 这是一张卫星地图截图，用红色标记指出阿比林地区机场，两条跑道与航站楼分明地铺在农田之间。
abi-doubao-06.webp.en: A satellite map screenshot with a red pin marking Abilene Regional Airport, its two runways, taxiways and terminal buildings laid out among farm fields.
